verdict.rationale: Beglaubigt.de is a German notarization/incorporation platform focused entirely on German entities (GmbH, UG) and German legal processes (ELSTER tax filing, Transparenzregister, Gewerbeanmeldung); there is no mention of Delaware, US corporate law, or US filings anywhere in the evidence. Delaware incorporation is a wrong-jurisdiction axis for this product's category, not a missing capability.
